pattern: {p:Player} create[s] a number of {t:TokenDesc} equal to {n:Qty}
subject: player

examples.text: You create a number of 2/2 white Knight creature tokens equal to your devotion to white.
Each opponent creates a number of Treasure tokens equal to the number of Pirates you control.
